reveal_en: The jellyfish Turritopsis dohrnii has a unique biological trick: when faced with environmental stress or injury, it can revert its adult cells back to their juvenile polyp stage, essentially restarting its life cycle.
reveal_zh: 笠水母拥有独特的生物学能力：当面临环境压力或受伤时，它能将成年细胞逆转回幼年水螅体阶段，从而重新开始生命周期。
meaning_en: This ability challenges our fundamental understanding of aging and mortality in complex organisms.
meaning_zh: 这一能力颠覆了我们对复杂生物衰老和死亡的基本认知。

visual.motion: A pulsating, flowing motion with bioluminescent elements.
